title: Crafted Item
description: A composed item produced by crafting: a base template + material, optionally engraved with a jewel, enchanted with permanent effects, or coated with a temporary consumable. Phase is inherited from the material unless overwritten by an engraving jewel. Effects coming from or through the item interact via Wuxing cycles in data/wuxing.

base_key.description: Key of the base equipment template (from equipment/weapons.json or armor.json).

phase.description: Effective element of the crafted item. Defaults to the material's phase. Overwritten by engraving_jewel's phase when present.

attack_bonus.description: Derived from material.weapon.attack. Added to the base weapon's damage or attack.

defense_bonus.description: Derived from material.armor.defense. Added to armor DR.

effect_magnitude_mult.description: Multiplier to enchantment/coating magnitudes. Base 1.0; material.ingredient.effectMagnitude adds to this.

engraving_jewel.description: Optional jewel engraved into the item. Overwrites the item's effective phase with the jewel's phase. In v1, this is the entire engraving mechanic — no additional effects.

gem_key.description: Key of the gem in data/gems/core.json.

phase.description: Gem's phase, which becomes the item's effective phase.

enchantments.description: Permanent magical effects on this item. Each entry is an appliedEffect from the shared registry. These persist as long as the item exists.

coatings.description: Temporary consumable effects applied to this item (poisons, oils). Each coating has uses_left that decrements on hit. When uses_left reaches 0, the coating is consumed and no longer applies.

duration.description: Seconds the effect runs per hit; 1, the default, is instant (schema.json appliedEffect).

uses_left.description: Number of hits or applications remaining before the coating is consumed.
